overview.Description: Quetta Acquisition Corporation does not have significant operations. The company focuses on entering into a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. It intends to target businesses that operate in the financial technology sector in Asia. Quetta Acquisition Corporation was incorporated in 2023 and is based in New York, New York.
